acceptanceCriteria: Claim and preview prefer a free lane explicitly reserved for the requested stage over unreserved lanes.
Unreserved lanes remain fallback when all matching lanes are busy or unavailable; stable pool order is retained within each tier.
Foreign-stage reservations and review isolation remain enforced; no-stage behavior stays unchanged.
Retain priority/fallback/isolation and preview/claim agreement checks; integrate verified change and complete native ticket.
body: Owner requested GitHub issue https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/371; isolated implementation based on origin/main; scoped verification and independent review required.
title: Tasks pools: prefer matching stage-reserved free lane
